name: Zeigarnik Effect
axiom: Unfinished tasks stay in memory longer than tasks already completed.
trigger: People return days later and remember exactly where they stopped.

checklist.text: Save progress automatically and offer to resume where the person stopped.
Show unfinished items on return; do not make people hunt for them.
End a session with a visible next step, not a blank confirmation.

antiPattern.violation: A half-finished application vanishes on reload, so the person starts over.
antiPattern.remediation: The draft is saved and the return screen names the next question.

academicOrigin.title: Über das Behalten von erledigten und unerledigten Handlungen
